name: Unfulfilled Glories (CR 3)
body:
Unfulfilled Glories
CR 3

Type insane
Notice Perception DC 20 (to hear the sound of pages rustling, as if a book were being read rapidly); hp 6
Trigger proximity; Reset automatic (24 hours)

EFFECT

Once the memories grow bitter and culminate in an overwhelming sense of depression and loss, the haunted PC must make a DC 14 Will save to resist taking 1d6 points of Wisdom damage.
